title: Excited to finally share some gameplay footage of my deckbuilder
author: LatentBlade
selftext:
I wanted to get my store up before I started posting gameplay videos so here it is. [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4650370/Cycle\_of\_the\_Unbroken/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4650370/Cycle_of_the_Unbroken/)

Everything needs work! What do you think of my disclaimer? Too much? All visual assets were initially generated using Nano Banana.  I'll show you how I did anything you want to learn about. Just ask! Thanks for encouraging me to use the best tools available to make something I'm proud of.

comments.author: blessed--
comments.body:
nice I made the same a little while ago

comments.author: HealthyWest6482
comments.body: ayyy nice grind. glad its shaping up

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: The disclaimer gave me a laugh.

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: So far it's not helping on tik tok. Idk if it would be better for them to have a different first impression or if it even matters. Maybe I'll A/B test with a different trailer.

replies.author: interestingsystems
replies.body: I think it's better not to lead with it in your marketing materials. Don't hide it, and make sure you state it on your store page. But it doesn't help with those who are not your audience, and it slows down the video for those who are your audience (with something they don't care about).

replies.author: Lucaslouch
replies.body: quite new on the topic, but is the issue about the assets, the code or both?

replies.author: interestingsystems
replies.body: AFAICT the anti-AI sentiment is mostly for asset generation - few people seem to care about coders getting replaced.

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: I think the consensus was from AI wars is I need to disclaim but I don't need it to be the first 5 seconds. A common recommendation was text over the game sample instead.

comments.author: LatentBlade
comments.body: I got lots of good feedback from AI wars. I never thought this trailer was very good. I wanted to get something out there for feed back on my game. It's definitely good to out unpolished stuff out there, take feedback, and make it better. This is just my first iteration 🙂
